system.description: On first take choose a track — Slaying, Research or Taming — gaining its basic tier; each level buys a new track's basics or upgrades one to advanced, then superior. Slaying: 2-IP hit-laced infusions, +5 damage (+10 vs Forte) with riders — superior tier ruled legal 6 Aug: Engineered inflicts through status immunity as printed (no Pressure interaction), Adaptive allowed. Research: cheaper Forte consumables, the spectrographic camera, the travelling lab. Taming: spoken commands to soldier-rank Forte creatures, then Capture (Companions on Loyalty Points, max three), then the Menagerie.
